item.description:
### Fixed - **Perch no longer risks a crash or a hang when its local socket server shuts down.** A connection that had been accepted but not yet handled could outlive the server, which either tripped a system check when the server was released or left the shutdown waiting on the socket forever. Found by the release checks on macOS 27, where the timing surfaced it.
### Changed - **Phone connections now use forward secrecy.** The link between your Mac and a paired phone or watch negotiates an ephemeral key on each connection, so a recording of past traffic on your network cannot be decrypted later even by someone who obtains the pairing secret. Nothing to re-pair: a phone running an older companion keeps connecting exactly as before, and picks up the stronger key exchange with its next update.
